sequence: Second craft run. Previous: craft_grades_2026-08-27.json (first run, the baseline). Run for #4773's last acceptance box: one /review lens before and after the Sonnet-panel change, with finding counts and verifier pass rate.
model: panel: sonnet (6 Agent-tool panelists, model=sonnet); verifiers: opus (5 finding-verifier agents, model=opus, frontmatter-pinned); driver + Phase-3 scoring: claude-opus-5-5 (session model)
method: /review craft per .claude/skills/review/SKILL.md (spine) + references/craft.md (rubric). Six-row promotion-committee panel (Eng I / Senior / Staff / Principal / EM / CIO), spawned in parallel on model=sonnet, each brief carrying the shared Phase-0 context block (inlined by reference to one scratch file every panelist read first). Every raw finding then went through finding-verifier (model=opus) in five area batches of 4-8, each batch seeded with one planted false finding; only CONFIRMED and strong-PLAUSIBLE count as upheld. Grades re-derived by the driver after refutations. Magnitudes from scripts/review_anchors.py and scripts/gate_census.py (none hand-typed). Rubric: docs/ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md D1-D10 A/C/F anchors at graded_sha. NOTE: the sealed anchor artifact has no 'craft' record (review_anchor_seal.py --lens craft exits 2), so the clauses graded are the A cells of ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md D1-D10 at 75e3a0071, fingerprinted only indirectly via anchor_freeze (which covers SKILL.md + craft.md, not the standards doc). Different method from 2026-08-27 (driver re-reproduction, no separate verifier, no planted controls) - the pass-rate comparison is therefore not like-for-like; see before_after.
headline: B overall (3 A-, 2 B+, 5 B). Up a notch within the band since 08-27: the missing merge gate (D7-1) and the frozen CI composite (D5-1) are fixed and D2 debt fell 42.7k -> 27.0k lines; the through-line 'machinery stronger than its self-description' persists in the docs (QUICKSTART commands, README doors, ruleset prose, mypy census, PROPORTIONALITY row). Sonnet panel: 29 raw, 21 upheld, 72.4% verifier pass rate, 5/5 planted controls refuted.
